title: Siluva – Vinod Kumar Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీవు మోసిన ఆ సిలువ నాదే యేసయ్య
నీవు పొందిన కొరడ దెబ్బలు నావే యేసయ్య
నీ తలపై ముళ్ళ కిరీటం నాదే యేసయ్య
english: Aaraadhana neeke naa aaraadhana neeke Yesayyaa neeke
Neevu pondhina koradaa debbalu naave Yesayya
Nee thalapai mulla kireetam naadhe Yesayya
translation: There is no one like You; there is no one like You.
There is no one who loves me like You do, Lord Jesus.
There is no one like You, Jesus, who would give His life for me.
There is no one like You, Jesus.
Adoration to You; my worship is for You alone, O Jesus.
The cross You carried was actually mine, O Jesus;
The stripes from the whip You received were meant for me.
The crown of thorns upon Your head was mine, O Jesus;
The nails in Your hands were meant for me.
By turning away the punishment from me and standing in my place,
You became the sacrifice on my behalf, O Jesus.

credits.Vocals: Pastor Vinod Kumar & Pastor Benjamin Johnson
credits.Music: Christ Alone Music & Eric Gerald & Jotham & Arjun & Deepak Cherian & Qompose studios

intro: Siluva is the latest Telugu Christian Good Friday song written & composed by Pastor Vinod Kumar, sung by Pastor Vinod Kumar, Pastor Benjamin Johnson and music composed by Christ Alone Music, Eric Gerald, Jotham, Arjun, Deepak Cherian, Qompose studios, produced by Christ Alone Team. This song was released on March 25, 2026, through Pastor Vinod Kumar YouTube Channel.
